fase_kegiatan: Konstruksi & Rantai Pasok Instalasi PLTS Atap (Batas Bawah Konservatif)
tipe_struktur_target: Rooftop Dak Beton Standar (RSUD, Sekolah, Kampus, Mall, Pasar, Stadion)
kalimat_verbatim: Instalasi kumulatif 1 GWp PLTS atap dapat menyerap tenaga kerja langsung 20.000 – 30.000 orang per tahun (angka konservatif) serta menurunkan emisi GRK hingga 1,05 juta ton per tahun. Pengembangan PLTS atap ini akan berguna bagi pemerintah Indonesia dalam memulihkan ekonomi pasca Covid-19.

dokumen_sumber: Renewable Energy Benefits: Leveraging Local Capacity for Solar PV (ISBN 978-92-9260-030-3)
fase_kegiatan: Instalasi Langsung & Sambungan Jaringan (Installation & Grid Connection)
tipe_struktur_target: Pembangkit Tenaga Surya Fotovoltaik (Fasilitas Standar 50 MW)
basis_metrik_asli: 39.380 person-days per 50 MWp (setara 787,6 person-days/MWp atau 3,03 FTE/MWp basis 260 hari kerja)
kalimat_verbatim: Installing and connecting a 50 MW solar plant takes about 39,380 person-days of labour. The most labour-intensive activity is site preparation and civil works, which accounts for more than half of the total (16,600 person-days). This activity is always sourced domestically, creating many opportunities for employment, especially for low- to medium-skilled workers.

dokumen_sumber: Renewable Energy Benefits: Leveraging Local Capacity for Solar PV (ISBN 978-92-9260-030-3)
fase_kegiatan: Operasional & Pemeliharaan Jangka Panjang (Operation & Maintenance / O&M)
basis_metrik_asli: 13.560 person-days per tahun untuk 50 MWp (setara 271,2 person-days/MWp/tahun atau 1,04 s.d. 1,8 FTE/MWp)
kalimat_verbatim: Operating and maintaining a 50 MW solar PV plant requires an average of 13,560 person-days for every year of the lifetime of the facility. Close to 86 percent for maintenance (between 9,950 and 13,300 person-days per year) and 14 percent of the labour is needed for operations (over 1,900 person-days per year).
